body: This will need some work in Smallrye, at the moment there is a hard dependency within smallrye itself.

@stuartwdouglas will you forward this issue to smallrye?

As I understand, smallrye-fault-tolerance get a MetricRegistry from CDI, so maybe we can add a no-op MetricRegistryto Arc if none already exist. With this we will be able to move the dependency from ` quarkus-smallrye-metrics` to `smallrye-metrics`.

AFAIU, to get rid of this dependency, we would need to remove all compile-time metric-related dependencies from SmallRye FT and somehow make them optional. Sounds doable, but not very easy.

I'm starting to realize that if we really want to unify the way extensions register metrics, this will, among other things, need a unified strategy in all SmallRye projects that would be compatible with the Quarkus strategy. The problem is when metrics are registered directly by the SmallRye project's code, then we can't reasonably use any sort of Quarkus-specific `MetricBuildItem` or whatever we want to do.
CC @Ladicek

Currently, the MicroProfile Fault Tolerance spec requires all implementations to publish metrics. It also defines a a switch that can be used to turn metrics off (`MP_Fault_Tolerance_Metrics_Enabled`). There's a noop metrics collector in SmallRye Fault Tolerance already, which is used when the config property it set to `false`, so there should be nothing preventing the Quarkus extension to selectively enable/disable metrics.

@Ladicek so this switch must be turned off on the build if the Quarkus metrics capability is not present ?
Let me try this

@Ladicek even if the metrics are turned off smallrye inject the metrics registry in [MetricsCollectorFactory.java](https://github.com/smallrye/smallrye-fault-tolerance/blob/master/implementation/src/main/java/io/smallrye/faulttolerance/metrics/MetricsCollectorFactory.java#L39) so we have a `javax.enterprise.inject.UnsatisfiedResolutionException: Unsatisfied dependency for type org.eclipse.microprofile.metrics.MetricRegistry and qualifiers [@Default]`

@Ladicek @jmartisk by switching the config OFF and providing a NOOP Metrics Registry it works, not very elegant, but it works: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/compare/master...loicmathieu:fix/smallrye-metrics-depdendency

If you think it's OK I can prepare a PR (more tests and some cleanup needed).

Ah, true. I'm looking into SmallRye FT and there's quite a lot of places that refer to the `MetricRegistry` class. It would require some amount of (boring) work to abstract that out. I think that providing a noop implementation of `MetricRegistry` is easiest, but you will only get rid of the SmallRye Metrics dependency. You will still need MicroProfile Metrics present.
I think the approach is OK. WDYT @jmartisk?

Sounds good. I didn't quite check whether SR-FT does anything more than just inject the `MetricRegistry` and call its methods, in which case the no-op registry trick might not be enough just by itself, but perhaps it will. 
We will still include the MP Metrics API in applications (or part of it, perhaps dead code elimination will do some work) but it's the best we can do for the moment, I guess
OK, cool, I will do some testing and cleanup and open a PR for this.
